name: get_campus_day
description: Return confirmed Campus agenda events for one specific calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). An empty result means no confirmed agenda event for that date; do not infer one from the recurring weekly schedule. Includes live-clock academicContext. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. If calendarRegistration.required is true on first use or after week 19, inspect the official PUCP page, call set_academic_calendar, and retry before making a week-dependent claim.

forceRefresh.description: Queue a metadata-only refresh while returning the last good cache.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
